meta.title: Poker3 · Las Vegas Poker Field Guide
meta.strictRule: A pass must be one entry total, with no re-entry, rebuy, add-on, or paid chip-boost. If the official terms are silent or unclear, the event stays unverified—not eligible.
meta.summary: A source-linked Las Vegas poker schedule, room guide, sample hotel comparison, and route estimates. Research snapshot only; confirm live schedules, terms, prices, and availability with each property before traveling.

flags.title: No strict-entry event is verified
flags.finding: The current official evidence either documents re-entry/paid chip boosts or does not establish the full entry rules. No event is marked eligible.
flags.next: Ask the room for the current structure sheet and written confirmation of one entry total, no re-entry/rebuy, no add-on, and no paid chip bonus before registering.

flags.title: Venetian one-day structures leave entry limits open
flags.finding: Several upcoming one-day sheets list blind structures and event details but do not explicitly prove one entry total or rule out add-ons. Multi-flight sheets are also not single-entry proof.
flags.next: Confirm the specific event number's full terms with tournament staff; keep every such event in Review until then.

flags.title: Westgate freezeout is an unverified lead
flags.finding: A third-party calendar lists $70 NLH freezeouts, but Westgate's official room page only says tournaments are available daily and does not publish the freezeout schedule or rules.
flags.next: Call the Westgate poker room and ask for the current tournament flyer and written confirmation; do not count the third-party listing as a match.

flags.title: Horseshoe sample rate is not an all-in total
flags.finding: The dated Dec. 10–14 page showed $300/night including a $50 resort fee, excluding taxes, but also itemized $49.95 plus $6.68 tax and displayed a technical-difficulties message.
flags.next: Re-run the official checkout for the actual dates and save the room, nightly breakdown, fee, taxes, and final total before comparing properties.

flags.title: Other hotel rates are not comparable for the sample stay
flags.finding: Venetian prices were placeholders; Wynn's response showed Nov. 16–17 rather than Dec. 10–14; Treasure Island's $69 NFR price is a starting offer only and does not cover the full sample stay.
flags.next: Use the actual arrival/departure and guest count on each official booking engine; do not turn starting rates into a four-night total.

flags.title: Walking times are third-party estimates
flags.finding: Rome2Rio route pages provide approximate walk times, but no property-confirmed route times were found. Casino entrances and indoor distances can add time.
flags.next: Verify the route in a current pedestrian map and allow extra time on event days.

flags.title: South Point tournament rules need image-level review
flags.finding: The current official daily schedule and rule sheets are published as images; the text extraction did not expose all entry/re-entry/add-on details.
flags.next: Inspect the exact event's sheet or ask the poker room; no South Point event is counted as strict-entry eligible.

flags.title: Bellagio Saturday PDF conflicts with the current schedule
flags.finding: The current poker page lists Saturday $1,000 NLH, while its linked structure says $1,100 and references a past Sept. 13 Day 2.
flags.next: Do not publish Saturday structure terms until Bellagio supplies a current flyer.

flags.title: The sample dates are a working assumption
flags.finding: No actual travel dates were supplied. Dec. 10–14, 2026 is used only because it was the dated booking-search window; it is not a recommended or confirmed trip.
flags.next: Replace the sample dates and guest count with the traveler's real details before making a hotel comparison or day plan.
